verdict.rationale: ZCode's own docs describe Goal, which plans, executes and verifies multi-step work continuously. They also describe remotely triggering tasks via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram so they start executing. That is autonomous, one-off task execution, but nothing documents configuring automations that run on a recurring schedule or event trigger unattended in the background. missing for 10: configurable scheduled or recurring automations, documented background/unattended execution, trigger configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: 用 Goal 管理复杂目标，持续规划、执行与验证，让多步骤工作稳步推进。
通过微信、飞书或 Telegram 远程唤起 ZCode，让任务随时进入执行状态。
